Container.Name: Veyra
Container.Overview: Veyra is a Jellyfin/Emby dashboard with Seerr request, queue, calendar, and admin operations views.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Veyra web interface.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and encrypted setup data.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Required. At least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Required. Exactly 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 16

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: SQLite database path inside the container.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure
Config.Description: Use false for direct local HTTP. Use true when Veyra is served behind HTTPS.

Config.Name: App Base URL
Config.Description: External Veyra URL, for example http://tower.local:3767 or https://veyra.example.com.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy CIDRs
Config.Description: Comma-separated trusted proxy CIDRs when Veyra is behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user id. Unraid default nobody is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group id. Unraid default users group is 100.

Config.Name: Media Server Type
Config.Description: Optional for wizard mode. Set to jellyfin or emby to skip first-run media server setup.

Config.Name: Media Server URL
Config.Description: Internal Jellyfin/Emby URL reachable from the Veyra container.

Config.Name: Media Server Public URL
Config.Description: Browser-facing Jellyfin/Emby URL.

Config.Name: Media Server API Key
Config.Description: Jellyfin/Emby API key. Optional for wizard mode.

Config.Name: Seerr URL
Config.Description: Optional internal Seerr URL reachable from the Veyra container.

Config.Name: Seerr Public URL
Config.Description: Browser-facing Seerr URL.

Config.Name: Seerr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Seerr API key for search, requests, quotas, and recent request status.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Optional Sonarr URL for queue, calendar, and admin status.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Sonarr API key.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Optional Radarr URL for queue, calendar, and admin status.

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Radarr API key.

Config.Name: Prowlarr URL
Config.Description: Optional Prowlarr URL for admin status.

Config.Name: Prowlarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Prowlarr API key.
